title.en: Turn Today’s Sprint into an automatic five-skill coach
title.zh: 把今日速成升级为自动五技能教练

purpose.en: Make each five-minute Sprint a focused sequence of five SmartCard vocabulary questions, three automatic pronunciation analyses, sentence reading, listening and writing, with a visible countdown and a five-minute extension choice.
purpose.zh: 让每个五分钟速成回合依次完成五个 SmartCard 词汇题、自动三遍发音分析、句子跟读、听力与写作，并提供清晰倒计时和五分钟续时选择。

en: Show target-language phonetics on every Sprint vocabulary card before it is flipped.
Use exactly five vocabulary cards in each five-minute round.
After an answer, automatically model, listen, score, and analyze pronunciation three times with no repeat or Continue buttons.
Automatically continue into sentence reading, meaning choice, listening word assembly, writing word assembly, and final speaking.
Show a live countdown and ask whether to add five minutes when time reaches zero; No exits the Sprint.
zh: 每张速成词汇卡翻面前直接显示目标语言音标。
每个五分钟回合固定学习五个词。
答题后自动完成三遍 AI 示范、收音、评分与分析，不再显示重读或继续按钮。
随后自动进入句子跟读与选义、听力组句、写作组句和最终口语。
显示实时倒计时；归零时询问是否增加五分钟，选择否则退出速成。

en: Anonymous and signed-in Today’s Sprint
Vocabulary and sentence practice
Pronunciation analysis
Sprint countdown
Administrator Project report
zh: 匿名及登录用户今日速成
词汇与句子练习
发音分析
速成倒计时
管理员 Project 报告

en: Reduce each Sprint round from ten vocabulary cards to five while retaining server-derived scoring.
Reuse SmartCard pronunciation scoring for three automatic speech-analysis turns.
Lock sentence meaning choices until all three reading turns are complete.
Auto-advance listening and writing after feedback without a Continue action.
Add countdown, five-minute extension, and explicit quit behavior.
zh: 将每个速成回合从十张词汇卡调整为五张，同时继续由服务器计算成绩。
复用 SmartCard 发音评分完成三次自动语音分析。
三遍句子跟读全部完成后才解锁词义选择。
听力和写作答题反馈后自动前进，不再要求点击继续。
加入倒计时、延长五分钟和明确退出逻辑。

en: Run the verified production build, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, TypeScript, and all repository tests.
Use real Chrome and Safari to verify phonetics, five-card progress, automatic three-turn analysis, and the absence of repeat and Continue buttons.
Exercise the production sequence through vocabulary, reading, listening, writing, speaking, countdown, and exit or extension behavior.
zh: 执行正式构建、敏感数据扫描、产物验证、TypeScript 与全部仓库测试。
使用真实 Chrome 与 Safari 验证音标、五词进度、自动三遍分析以及没有重读和继续按钮。
在生产环境走查词汇、阅读、听力、写作、口语、倒计时以及退出或续时流程。

en: A genuine pronunciation score still requires real learner microphone speech; silence remains an explicit zero-score path rather than fabricated evidence.
zh: 真实发音评分仍需要学习者通过麦克风发声；静音时明确计为零分，不会伪造语音证据。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific learning-game release and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习游戏发布，不改变其他站点。
